title: Breathedge
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#782, 2026-10-29), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal, rated 4 of 5 after 5 minutes: no DualSense support, which works when the game is started through Steam with Steam Input, the Epic copy. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on an M1 with D3DMetal (Epic).

knownIssues.symptom: DualSense controller not recognized by the game (an Xbox style XInput pad works)
knownIssues.fix: use an XInput pad, or start the game through Steam with Steam Input on (a non-Steam shortcut in the environment's Steam), as the reporter found with Breathedge
